Mini Festival Gift Cards

Go cash-free when you purchase a Disney Gift Card featuring a unique festival-themed design.
Go cash-free when you purchase a Disney Gift Card featuring a unique festival-themed design.

Scan your mini festival Disney Gift Card to pay for food, merchandise and more. These cards can be activated with as little as $15. Acceptable forms of payment include credit cards, cash and MagicBands.

You can find mini festival Disney Gift Cards at any festival kiosk throughout the park and at the following locations:

  • Port of Entry
  • Creations Shop
  • World Traveler at International Gateway
  • Gateway Gifts

Disney Gift Cards can be reloaded at any merchandise location owned and operated by Disney, including those listed above.

Mini festival Disney Gift Cards are only available for purchase during the 2026 EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival, and are not available for pre-order.

Photo-Worthy Moments

Here are just a few festival-themed Disney PhotoPass offerings.

  • Waiter Mickey Magic Shot

    Add flavorful flair to your festival photos around World Showcase.

  • Swedish Chef Magic Shot

    Cook up some fun with this Muppets-themed Magic Shot in World Celebration.

  • Leaning Tower of Cheeza Magic Shot

    Get a taste of '90s nostalgia with a Magic Shot inspired by A Goofy Movie, in the Italy Pavilion.

  • Elemental Magic Shot

    Add flair with this sizzling effect, available on the path from Spaceship Earth to CommuniCore Hall.

  • Giant Empanada Magic Shot

    Celebrate Latin cuisine with a whimsical snapshot in the Mexico Pavilion.

  • International Balloons Magic Shot

    Capture your global adventure with this vibrant photo op at select spots in World Celebration.
